name: Login config carries the auction deposit rate the sell frame needs
contract: Issues #7446, #7409 and #6695: the client's CalculateAuctionDeposit override (Interface\FrameXML\Util\GlobalOverwrites.lua:196 in patch-B.MPQ) multiplies every non-vanity deposit by C_Config.GetRateConfig("RATE_AUCTION_DEPOSIT") with no fallback. Without that key the sell frame raises a Lua error and Create Auction stays disabled. Expected: the login SMSG_UPDATE_CONFIGS (0x058D) packet names RATE_AUCTION_DEPOSIT.

steps.label: It carries the auction deposit rate
